title: Sausage Baked Ziti

items: 1 Tbsp kosher salt (for the pasta water)
1 lb bulk Italian sausage (or links with casings removed)
¼ cup torn fresh basil leaves

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F with a rack in the middle. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add the 1 Tbsp salt.
Cook the ziti 2 min less than the package says so it stays firm while it bakes. Drain.

Meanwhile, cook the sausage and onion in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat 8–10 min, breaking up the sausage, until browned with no pink left (160°F). Spoon off extra fat. Stir in the garlic for 30 sec, then the marinara, and simmer 5 min.
In a bowl, stir together the ricotta, egg and ¼ cup parmesan.
Toss the ziti with the sausage sauce. Spread half in a 9×13-inch baking dish, dot with spoonfuls of the ricotta mixture, then cover with the rest of the pasta.
Sprinkle the mozzarella and the remaining ¼ cup parmesan over the top. Cover tightly with foil, tented so it doesn't touch the cheese.
Bake covered 20 min. Uncover and bake 15–20 min more, until the sauce bubbles at the edges and the cheese is melted and spotted brown.
Rest 10 min so it sets and scoops cleanly. Scatter the basil over the top and serve.
tips: Make ahead: assemble, cover and refrigerate up to 24 hr. Bake covered 30 min, then uncovered 20 min, until the center reads 165°F.
Undercooking the pasta matters. Fully cooked ziti turns mushy after 35 min in the oven.
storage: Fridge up to 4 days. Freezer up to 3 months, wrapped well. Reheat portions in the microwave, or the covered dish in a 350°F oven 20–30 min, until the center reaches 165°F.
